Package Logic

Class Controller

java.lang.Object
Logic.Controller
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class Controller extends Object implements Runnable
This class is used to control the client. It communicates with the server with a TCP socket.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      This method starts a socket in port 6002 (the same as the server). It then starts to read from the stream and get different values. If -1: the game is over and switch back to SnakeMenu. If -2: getHSList() is called to store the HS-list. If -5: setting panel values. When IO exception is caught; the connection reconnects.
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable

    • startSocket

      public void startSocket()
      This method starts a socket on the host and port. If IO exception get caught isConnected sets as false to stop receive from server and the panel sets to mainMenu.
